_doc: In-match SCREEN geometry, read from the Figma screen frames. Companion to figma_hud_layout.json.
_authority: Authoritative for POSITION. Component pages are authoritative for a component's art and size; they have no screen and can never answer 'where'.
_sample_data_warning: EVERY gamertag in the Scoreboard frame is sample text and several are Halo-team handles - '343 Connmando', '343 Parfit', '343 Ellis', '343 Cliffton', '343 Meowlnir'. They are placeholders in a mock, NOT content. No shipped string, test fixture or default may carry them.

scoreboard.name: HUD - Scoreboard (TAB) - MEASURED 1:1
scoreboard._scene: Blurred behind. The frame name states it does NOT pause a live match - so this screen must NOT be pushed onto a layer that suspends gameplay input handling.

team_blocks._note: Emblems are ORIGINAL ART per the frame name.

columns._note: Column x are ROW-LOCAL. The header labels at y157 use x816.5/900/983/1066.5, which are CANVAS coords - 465+356.5=821.5 vs 816.5, a 5px disagreement between header and cell. Recorded, not reconciled.

team_fill._note: 88 = 4 rows x 22, contiguous - a per-row background would show seams

local_player._note: The accent sits at x460, OUTSIDE the 465 table - it overhangs left. An HBox cannot express that; it is an Overlay offset.

table._col_tint_note: Alternating column tints run the FULL table height (282), spanning both teams and the divider. They are table furniture, not row state.

death_respawn.name: HUD - Death / Respawn (ORIGINAL: only the kill cam is documented)
death_respawn._original: Marked ORIGINAL in the frame name - no reference supplies this screen, so nothing can be checked against a source.
death_respawn._designer_annotation: Node 36:21 is a frame literally named 'C++ GAP' at (40,40,420,46) with two lines W1/W2. The designer annotated the missing producers INSIDE the mock. Read it before building.

respawn_ring._note: Ring TRACK and SWEEP are separate 104px circles - the sweep is a radial fill, which UMG cannot do with a ProgressBar. Tier-4 material.

match_state._note: Match state PERSISTS THROUGH DEATH - same data as the HUD band, different layout. Bind the same UBRVM_Match fields; do not fork a second source.
